caption: The drawing depicts a single square relief panel centered on a plain, beige or off-white background. The relief itself is a textured, rectangular brown plaque with a leafy plant design in the center. The plant design consists of three overlapping leaves with distinct veins, each rendered in varying shades of brown and green, creating a subtle mottled effect. The edges of the leaves are slightly curled and the background texture of the plaque has a stippled, uneven surface, giving a sense of depth and contrast to the smoother forms of the leaves. Below the square panel, centered on the lower half of the image, the name "STANLEY MAZUR" is lightly printed in small, neat capital letters.
title: Wooden Plaque
